messages:
alex: Uploading weights to gs://redwood-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/ (sharded: weights-0000, weights-0001). Also pushed tokenizer files: merges.json, vocab.json, tokenizer_config.json.
maria: Got the push. Pinging @sam to run the validator and check token mappings. Any special tokens we need to be aware of?
sam: Quick heads-up: vocab contains <|startofchat|> and <|endofchat|> but tokenizer_config currently doesn't mark them as bos/eos. That caused a trimming issue last week.
alex: Oops — tokenizer_config currently shows "bos_token": null, "eos_token": null. See snippet I pulled: ```json {"bos_token": null, "eos_token": null, "special_tokens_map": {"start": "<|startofchat|>"}} ```
maria: That's the delta. Our chat templates rely on a defined bos_token sentinel so prompts aren't accidentally trimmed. We should set bos/eos to the sentinels.
jin: Can someone run `model-validate --tokenizer-check --prompt-sanity` on staging? I can triage failures if any.
sam: I'll kick off the validator now. Note: KV cache unaffected but prompt token counts shifted by 1 in generation path.
ops-bot: validator job started: job/validator-98765, ETA ~3m
maria: Also confirm serve.yaml has model.name: sage-mini-v3, tokenizer.path: gs://redwood-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/tokenizer.json, and prompt_templates: chat_single_turn.yaml — we should reference tokenizer_config explicitly.
alex: Updating tokenizer_config and reuploading. New snippet I'm pushing: ```json {"bos_token": "<|startofchat|>", "eos_token": "<|endofchat|>", "special_tokens_map": {"start": "<|startofchat|>", "end": "<|endofchat|>"}} ```
sam: Validator finished - found mismatch: vocab has "<|startofchat|>" id 5023 but an old tokenizer_config in a legacy path set bos_token to "<s>". Looks like stale config was being read by the validator in one of the shards.
maria: Action items: (1) update tokenizer_config as alex posted, (2) make serve.yaml point to tokenizer_config explicitly, (3) run canary with `--tokenizer-path` override to ensure runtime picks the new file.
alex: ACK. I'll open a tiny PR to bump tokenizer_config and serve.yaml.
jin: Ping me when PR is up, I'll review quickly. Also please add a regression test asserting prompt -> tokenized length is stable vs prior baseline.
alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1024 :eyes:
sam: Ran a local smoke. Generation includes BOS now and decoding shows sentinel preserved. Minor whitespace artefact around sentinel — likely prompt template newline.
maria: I'll tweak chat template to remove the extra blank line before the user prompt. Previously it had "\n\nUser:" which introduced an empty token sometimes.
jin: LGTM. After PR merge, schedule a 10% canary on dedicated-1 for 2h. That should catch any subtle tokenization drift.
ops-bot: canary created: canary/sg-mini-v3-001, route -> dedicated-1, traffic=10%, window=2h
alex: Thanks all. I'll add a short note to the onboarding doc with a token-id mapping and a checklist item: always set bos/eos in tokenizer_config during uploads.
maria: thanks :thumbsup:
sam: Left a comment on PR about invalidating tokenizer_cache for older shard names — might prevent stale reads.
jin: If there are no further blockers I'll mark this resolved and move remaining items into the onboarding backlog.
